contexts.text: To inflame them () = to kindle with cupidities.
Inflamed with the fire of the love of self.
This flame is what is called anger. Hence it is that man is said... to be inflamed, when he is angry.
Naked men with an inflamed body (in the Fifth Earth). AC 10757.
Hence it is that a man... is inflamed when his love is exalted into zeal, anger, and wrath.
Some... stood there with inflamed eyes...
Truths... are said to be inflamed () from the fire of the love of self and of the world.

By the sons of man who are set on fire () are signified those who are in the truths of the Church... who are said to be set on fire by the conceit of Own intelligence. ( = that they are possessed by corporeal love. AE 750:17.)
